test_case.sql:
WITH deployed_relationship_columns AS
(
    SELECT
        tr.relationship_name
       ,tr.source_database
       ,tr.source_table
       ,tr.source_column
       ,TRIM(src.ColumnType) AS source_column_type
       ,src.ColumnLength AS source_column_length
       ,src.DecimalTotalDigits AS source_decimal_total_digits
       ,src.DecimalFractionalDigits AS source_decimal_fractional_digits
       ,TRIM(src.CharType) AS source_char_type
       ,tr.target_database
       ,tr.target_table
       ,tr.target_column
       ,TRIM(tgt.ColumnType) AS target_column_type
       ,tgt.ColumnLength AS target_column_length
       ,tgt.DecimalTotalDigits AS target_decimal_total_digits
       ,tgt.DecimalFractionalDigits AS target_decimal_fractional_digits
       ,TRIM(tgt.CharType) AS target_char_type
    FROM CallCentre_SEM_STD_V.table_relationship tr
    INNER JOIN DBC.ColumnsV src
        ON src.DatabaseName = tr.source_database
       AND src.TableName = tr.source_table
       AND src.ColumnName = tr.source_column
    INNER JOIN DBC.ColumnsV tgt
        ON tgt.DatabaseName = tr.target_database
       AND tgt.TableName = tr.target_table
       AND tgt.ColumnName = tr.target_column
    WHERE COALESCE(tr.is_active, 1) = 1
      AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM CallCentre_SEM_STD_V.data_product_map module_scope
    WHERE COALESCE(module_scope.is_active, 1) = 1
      AND UPPER(COALESCE(TRIM(module_scope.deployment_status), 'DEPLOYED')) = 'DEPLOYED'
      AND (
          UPPER(TRIM(module_scope.database_name)) = UPPER(TRIM(tr.source_database))
          OR UPPER(OREPLACE(OREPLACE(TRIM(module_scope.database_name), '_STD_T', '_STD_V'), '_BUS_V', '_STD_V'))
                = UPPER(TRIM(tr.source_database))
          OR UPPER(OREPLACE(OREPLACE(TRIM(module_scope.database_name), '_STD_T', '_BUS_V'), '_STD_V', '_BUS_V'))
                = UPPER(TRIM(tr.source_database))
      )
)
      AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM CallCentre_SEM_STD_V.data_product_map module_scope
    WHERE COALESCE(module_scope.is_active, 1) = 1
      AND UPPER(COALESCE(TRIM(module_scope.deployment_status), 'DEPLOYED')) = 'DEPLOYED'
      AND (
          UPPER(TRIM(module_scope.database_name)) = UPPER(TRIM(tr.target_database))
          OR UPPER(OREPLACE(OREPLACE(TRIM(module_scope.database_name), '_STD_T', '_STD_V'), '_BUS_V', '_STD_V'))
                = UPPER(TRIM(tr.target_database))
          OR UPPER(OREPLACE(OREPLACE(TRIM(module_scope.database_name), '_STD_T', '_BUS_V'), '_STD_V', '_BUS_V'))
                = UPPER(TRIM(tr.target_database))
      )
)
      AND UPPER(TRIM(tr.source_table)) NOT LIKE '%\_BKP\_%' ESCAPE '\'
      AND UPPER(TRIM(tr.source_table)) NOT LIKE '%\_BK\_%' ESCAPE '\'
      AND UPPER(TRIM(tr.target_table)) NOT LIKE '%\_BKP\_%' ESCAPE '\'
      AND UPPER(TRIM(tr.target_table)) NOT LIKE '%\_BK\_%' ESCAPE '\'
),
relationship_type_issues AS
(
    SELECT
        relationship_name
       ,source_database
       ,source_table
       ,source_column
       ,source_column_type
       ,source_column_length
       ,source_decimal_total_digits
       ,source_decimal_fractional_digits
       ,source_char_type
       ,target_database
       ,target_table
       ,target_column
       ,target_column_type
       ,target_column_length
       ,target_decimal_total_digits
       ,target_decimal_fractional_digits
       ,target_char_type
       ,CASE
            WHEN source_column_type <> target_column_type
                THEN 'JOIN_COLUMN_TYPE_MISMATCH'
            WHEN COALESCE(source_char_type, '') <> COALESCE(target_char_type, '')
                THEN 'JOIN_COLUMN_CHARSET_MISMATCH'
            WHEN COALESCE(source_decimal_total_digits, -1)
                    <> COALESCE(target_decimal_total_digits, -1)
              OR COALESCE(source_decimal_fractional_digits, -1)
                    <> COALESCE(target_decimal_fractional_digits, -1)
                THEN 'JOIN_COLUMN_PRECISION_SCALE_MISMATCH'
            WHEN COALESCE(source_column_length, -1) <> COALESCE(target_column_length, -1)
                THEN 'JOIN_COLUMN_LENGTH_MISMATCH'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS issue_code
    FROM deployed_relationship_columns
    WHERE source_column_type <> target_column_type
       OR COALESCE(source_char_type, '') <> COALESCE(target_char_type, '')
       OR COALESCE(source_decimal_total_digits, -1)
            <> COALESCE(target_decimal_total_digits, -1)
       OR COALESCE(source_decimal_fractional_digits, -1)
            <> COALESCE(target_decimal_fractional_digits, -1)
       OR COALESCE(source_column_length, -1) <> COALESCE(target_column_length, -1)
)
SELECT
    relationship_name
   ,source_database
   ,source_table
   ,source_column
   ,source_column_type
   ,source_column_length
   ,source_decimal_total_digits
   ,source_decimal_fractional_digits
   ,source_char_type
   ,target_database
   ,target_table
   ,target_column
   ,target_column_type
   ,target_column_length
   ,target_decimal_total_digits
   ,target_decimal_fractional_digits
   ,target_char_type
   ,issue_code
   ,'Align relationship join column datatype, length, precision, scale and character set before generated SQL uses this join.' AS repair_hint
FROM relationship_type_issues
ORDER BY 1, 18, 2, 3, 4;

test_case.name: Similar table column names use consistent datatypes
test_case.repair_strategy: Review same/similar table column names with different physical type signatures. Align datatypes where they participate in joins, filters or generated SQL.
test_case.sql:
WITH product_columns AS
(
    SELECT
        UPPER(OREPLACE(TRIM(colv.ColumnName), '_', '')) AS normalised_column_name
       ,TRIM(colv.DatabaseName) AS database_name
       ,TRIM(colv.TableName) AS table_name
       ,TRIM(colv.ColumnName) AS column_name
       ,TRIM(colv.ColumnType) AS column_type
       ,colv.ColumnLength AS column_length
       ,colv.DecimalTotalDigits AS decimal_total_digits
       ,colv.DecimalFractionalDigits AS decimal_fractional_digits
       ,TRIM(colv.ColumnType)
            || ':' || CAST(COALESCE(colv.ColumnLength, 0) AS VARCHAR(20))
            || ':' || CAST(COALESCE(colv.DecimalTotalDigits, 0) AS VARCHAR(20))
            || ':' || CAST(COALESCE(colv.DecimalFractionalDigits, 0) AS VARCHAR(20))
            AS type_signature
    FROM DBC.ColumnsV colv
    INNER JOIN DBC.TablesV tv
        ON tv.DatabaseName = colv.DatabaseName
       AND tv.TableName = colv.TableName
    WHERE colv.DatabaseName LIKE 'CallCentre\_%' ESCAPE '\'
      AND tv.TableKind = 'T'
      AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM CallCentre_SEM_STD_V.data_product_map module_scope
    WHERE COALESCE(module_scope.is_active, 1) = 1
      AND UPPER(COALESCE(TRIM(module_scope.deployment_status), 'DEPLOYED')) = 'DEPLOYED'
      AND (
          UPPER(TRIM(module_scope.database_name)) = UPPER(TRIM(colv.DatabaseName))
          OR UPPER(OREPLACE(OREPLACE(TRIM(module_scope.database_name), '_STD_T', '_STD_V'), '_BUS_V', '_STD_V'))
                = UPPER(TRIM(colv.DatabaseName))
          OR UPPER(OREPLACE(OREPLACE(TRIM(module_scope.database_name), '_STD_T', '_BUS_V'), '_STD_V', '_BUS_V'))
                = UPPER(TRIM(colv.DatabaseName))
      )
)
      AND UPPER(TRIM(colv.TableName)) NOT LIKE '%\_BKP\_%' ESCAPE '\'
      AND UPPER(TRIM(colv.TableName)) NOT LIKE '%\_BK\_%' ESCAPE '\'
),
drifted_names AS
(
    SELECT
        normalised_column_name
    FROM product_columns
    GROUP BY normalised_column_name
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT type_signature) > 1
)
SELECT
    pc.normalised_column_name
   ,pc.database_name
   ,pc.table_name
   ,pc.column_name
   ,pc.column_type
   ,pc.column_length
   ,pc.decimal_total_digits
   ,pc.decimal_fractional_digits
   ,pc.type_signature
   ,'COLUMN_TYPE_DRIFT' AS issue_code
   ,'Align datatype, length, precision and scale for same/similar columns.' AS repair_hint
FROM product_columns pc
INNER JOIN drifted_names dn
    ON dn.normalised_column_name = pc.normalised_column_name
ORDER BY pc.normalised_column_name, pc.column_name, pc.database_name, pc.table_name;

test_case.name: Column metadata datatypes match deployed columns
test_case.repair_strategy: Refresh column_metadata.data_type from the deployed column catalogue.
test_case.sql:
SELECT
    cmeta.database_name
   ,cmeta.table_name
   ,cmeta.column_name
   ,cmeta.data_type AS metadata_data_type
   ,TRIM(colv.ColumnType) AS deployed_column_type
   ,'COLUMN_METADATA_DATATYPE_MISMATCH' AS issue_code
   ,'Refresh column_metadata.data_type from DBC.ColumnsV.' AS repair_hint
FROM CallCentre_SEM_STD_V.column_metadata cmeta
INNER JOIN DBC.ColumnsV colv
    ON colv.DatabaseName = cmeta.database_name
   AND colv.TableName = cmeta.table_name
   AND colv.ColumnName = cmeta.column_name
WHERE COALESCE(cmeta.is_active, 1) = 1
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM CallCentre_SEM_STD_V.data_product_map module_scope
    WHERE COALESCE(module_scope.is_active, 1) = 1
      AND UPPER(COALESCE(TRIM(module_scope.deployment_status), 'DEPLOYED')) = 'DEPLOYED'
      AND (
          UPPER(TRIM(module_scope.database_name)) = UPPER(TRIM(cmeta.database_name))
          OR UPPER(OREPLACE(OREPLACE(TRIM(module_scope.database_name), '_STD_T', '_STD_V'), '_BUS_V', '_STD_V'))
                = UPPER(TRIM(cmeta.database_name))
          OR UPPER(OREPLACE(OREPLACE(TRIM(module_scope.database_name), '_STD_T', '_BUS_V'), '_STD_V', '_BUS_V'))
                = UPPER(TRIM(cmeta.database_name))
      )
)
  AND UPPER(TRIM(cmeta.table_name)) NOT LIKE '%\_BKP\_%' ESCAPE '\'
      AND UPPER(TRIM(cmeta.table_name)) NOT LIKE '%\_BK\_%' ESCAPE '\'
  AND UPPER(cmeta.data_type) NOT LIKE
    CASE TRIM(colv.ColumnType)
        WHEN 'I' THEN '%INTEGER%'
        WHEN 'I1' THEN '%BYTEINT%'
        WHEN 'I2' THEN '%SMALLINT%'
        WHEN 'I8' THEN '%BIGINT%'
        WHEN 'D' THEN '%DECIMAL%'
        WHEN 'F' THEN '%FLOAT%'
        WHEN 'DA' THEN '%DATE%'
        WHEN 'TS' THEN '%TIMESTAMP%'
        WHEN 'TZ' THEN '%TIME%'
        WHEN 'AT' THEN '%TIME%'
        WHEN 'CV' THEN '%VARCHAR%'
        WHEN 'CF' THEN '%CHAR%'
        WHEN 'CO' THEN '%CLOB%'
        WHEN 'BO' THEN '%BLOB%'
        ELSE '%' || UPPER(TRIM(colv.ColumnType)) || '%'
    END
ORDER BY cmeta.database_name, cmeta.table_name, cmeta.column_name;

test_case.name: Data product primary views are deployed in BUS_V databases
test_case.repair_strategy: Create missing BUS_V views or refresh data_product_map.primary_views.
test_case.sql:
WITH module_primary_views AS
(
    SELECT
        dpm.module_name
       ,dpm.database_name AS physical_database_name
       ,OREPLACE(OREPLACE(dpm.database_name, '_STD_T', '_BUS_V'), '_STD_V', '_BUS_V') AS business_database_name
       ,TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(dpm.primary_views, '[^,]+', 1, token_numbers.token_number))
            AS primary_view_name
    FROM CallCentre_SEM_STD_V.data_product_map dpm
    CROSS JOIN
    (
        SELECT 1 AS token_number FROM DBC.DBCInfoV WHERE InfoKey = 'VERSION'
        UNION ALL SELECT 2 FROM DBC.DBCInfoV WHERE InfoKey = 'VERSION'
        UNION ALL SELECT 3 FROM DBC.DBCInfoV WHERE InfoKey = 'VERSION'
        UNION ALL SELECT 4 FROM DBC.DBCInfoV WHERE InfoKey = 'VERSION'
        UNION ALL SELECT 5 FROM DBC.DBCInfoV WHERE InfoKey = 'VERSION'
        UNION ALL SELECT 6 FROM DBC.DBCInfoV WHERE InfoKey = 'VERSION'
        UNION ALL SELECT 7 FROM DBC.DBCInfoV WHERE InfoKey = 'VERSION'
        UNION ALL SELECT 8 FROM DBC.DBCInfoV WHERE InfoKey = 'VERSION'
        UNION ALL SELECT 9 FROM DBC.DBCInfoV WHERE InfoKey = 'VERSION'
        UNION ALL SELECT 10 FROM DBC.DBCInfoV WHERE InfoKey = 'VERSION'
    ) token_numbers
    WHERE COALESCE(dpm.is_active, 1) = 1
      AND UPPER(COALESCE(TRIM(dpm.deployment_status), 'DEPLOYED')) = 'DEPLOYED'
      AND COALESCE(dpm.primary_views, '') NOT IN ('', 'None')
      AND REGEXP_SUBSTR(dpm.primary_views, '[^,]+', 1, token_numbers.token_number) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    module_name
   ,business_database_name
   ,primary_view_name
   ,'PRIMARY_VIEW_NOT_DEPLOYED' AS issue_code
   ,'Create the BUS_V view or update data_product_map.primary_views to the deployed view name.' AS repair_hint
FROM module_primary_views mpv
LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.TablesV tv
    ON tv.DatabaseName = mpv.business_database_name
   AND tv.TableName = mpv.primary_view_name
   AND tv.TableKind IN ('V', 'O', 'Q')
WHERE tv.TableName IS NULL
ORDER BY module_name, business_database_name, primary_view_name;

test_case.repair_strategy: Refresh DataProductsMaster_GOV_BUS_V.active_data_product_registry and its manifest_json so MCP clients discover the product, contract, semantic model, policy, quality, lineage and approved access path before querying data.
test_case.sql:
WITH active_registry AS
(
    SELECT
        product_id
       ,product_name
       ,product_version
       ,semantic_database
       ,semantic_view_database
       ,memory_database
       ,memory_view_database
       ,observability_database
       ,observability_view_database
       ,manifest_json
       ,contract_uri
       ,semantic_uri
       ,quality_uri
       ,lineage_uri
       ,policy_uri
       ,approved_entrypoint
       ,approved_access_mode
    FROM DataProductsMaster_GOV_BUS_V.active_data_product_registry
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(product_status)) = 'ACTIVE'
      AND (
          UPPER(TRIM(product_id)) = UPPER('CallCentre')
          OR UPPER(TRIM(product_name)) LIKE UPPER('CallCentre%')
          OR semantic_database = 'CallCentre_SEM_STD_V'
          OR semantic_view_database = 'CallCentre_SEM_STD_V'
      )
),
module_map AS
(
    SELECT
        UPPER(TRIM(module_name)) AS module_name
       ,TRIM(database_name) AS database_name
       ,OREPLACE(OREPLACE(TRIM(database_name), '_STD_T', '_STD_V'), '_BUS_V', '_STD_V')
            AS standard_view_database_name
       ,OREPLACE(OREPLACE(TRIM(database_name), '_STD_T', '_BUS_V'), '_STD_V', '_BUS_V')
            AS business_view_database_name
    FROM CallCentre_SEM_STD_V.data_product_map
    WHERE COALESCE(is_active, 1) = 1
),
registry_issues AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(128)) AS product_id
       ,'MISSING_PRODUCT_REGISTRY_ROW' AS issue_code
       ,'No active central registry row points to this data product.' AS issue_detail
       ,'Insert or refresh DataProductsMaster_GOV_BUS_V.active_data_product_registry for this data product.' AS repair_hint
    FROM DBC.DBCInfoV
    WHERE InfoKey = 'VERSION'
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM active_registry)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ar.product_id
       ,'MISSING_ORIENTATION_MANIFEST' AS issue_code
       ,'manifest_json is required for the MCP Data Product Orientation Layer.' AS issue_detail
       ,'Populate manifest_json with the discovery manifest and recommended navigation.' AS repair_hint
    FROM active_registry ar
    WHERE ar.manifest_json IS NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ar.product_id
       ,'MISSING_CONTRACT_URI' AS issue_code
       ,'contract_uri is required so clients inspect the product contract before data access.' AS issue_detail
       ,'Populate contract_uri with the contract MCP resource or document URI.' AS repair_hint
    FROM active_registry ar
    WHERE ar.contract_uri IS NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ar.product_id
       ,'MISSING_SEMANTIC_URI' AS issue_code
       ,'semantic_uri is required so clients can discover the semantic model from the manifest.' AS issue_detail
       ,'Populate semantic_uri with the semantic MCP resource or metadata URI.' AS repair_hint
    FROM active_registry ar
    WHERE ar.semantic_uri IS NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ar.product_id
       ,'MISSING_POLICY_URI' AS issue_code
       ,'policy_uri is required so clients inspect access rules before querying data.' AS issue_detail
       ,'Populate policy_uri with the access-policy MCP resource or policy URI.' AS repair_hint
    FROM active_registry ar
    WHERE ar.policy_uri IS NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ar.product_id
       ,'MISSING_APPROVED_ENTRYPOINT' AS issue_code
       ,'approved_entrypoint and approved_access_mode are required for governed data access.' AS issue_detail
       ,'Populate approved_entrypoint and approved_access_mode from the product access layer.' AS repair_hint
    FROM active_registry ar
    WHERE ar.approved_entrypoint IS NULL
       OR ar.approved_access_mode IS NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ar.product_id
       ,'SEMANTIC_DATABASE_NOT_IN_MODULE_MAP' AS issue_code
       ,'Registry semantic_database does not match an active Semantic module in data_product_map.' AS issue_detail
       ,'Refresh active_data_product_registry.semantic_database or Semantic.data_product_map.' AS repair_hint
    FROM active_registry ar
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM module_map mm
        WHERE mm.module_name = 'SEMANTIC'
          AND (
              mm.database_name = ar.semantic_database
              OR mm.database_name = ar.semantic_view_database
              OR mm.standard_view_database_name = ar.semantic_database
              OR mm.standard_view_database_name = ar.semantic_view_database
              OR mm.business_view_database_name = ar.semantic_database
              OR mm.business_view_database_name = ar.semantic_view_database
          )
    )

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ar.product_id
       ,'MEMORY_DATABASE_NOT_IN_MODULE_MAP' AS issue_code
       ,'Registry memory_database does not match an active Memory module in data_product_map.' AS issue_detail
       ,'Refresh active_data_product_registry.memory_database or Semantic.data_product_map.' AS repair_hint
    FROM active_registry ar
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM module_map mm
        WHERE mm.module_name = 'MEMORY'
    )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM module_map mm
        WHERE mm.module_name = 'MEMORY'
          AND (
              mm.database_name = ar.memory_database
              OR mm.database_name = ar.memory_view_database
              OR mm.standard_view_database_name = ar.memory_database
              OR mm.standard_view_database_name = ar.memory_view_database
              OR mm.business_view_database_name = ar.memory_database
              OR mm.business_view_database_name = ar.memory_view_database
          )
    )

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ar.product_id
       ,'OBSERVABILITY_DATABASE_NOT_IN_MODULE_MAP' AS issue_code
       ,'Registry observability_database does not match an active Observability module in data_product_map.' AS issue_detail
       ,'Refresh active_data_product_registry.observability_database or Semantic.data_product_map.' AS repair_hint
    FROM active_registry ar
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM module_map mm
        WHERE mm.module_name = 'OBSERVABILITY'
    )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM module_map mm
        WHERE mm.module_name = 'OBSERVABILITY'
          AND (
              mm.database_name = ar.observability_database
              OR mm.database_name = ar.observability_view_database
              OR mm.standard_view_database_name = ar.observability_database
              OR mm.standard_view_database_name = ar.observability_view_database
              OR mm.business_view_database_name = ar.observability_database
              OR mm.business_view_database_name = ar.observability_view_database
          )
    )

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ar.product_id
       ,'SEMANTIC_DATABASE_NOT_DEPLOYED' AS issue_code
       ,'Registry semantic_database is not visible in DBC.DatabasesV.' AS issue_detail
       ,'Deploy the Semantic database or refresh the registry to the deployed database name.' AS repair_hint
    FROM active_registry ar
    LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.DatabasesV dbv
        ON dbv.DatabaseName = ar.semantic_database
    WHERE dbv.DatabaseName IS NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ar.product_id
       ,'MEMORY_DATABASE_NOT_DEPLOYED' AS issue_code
       ,'Registry memory_database is not visible in DBC.DatabasesV.' AS issue_detail
       ,'Deploy the Memory database or refresh the registry to the deployed database name.' AS repair_hint
    FROM active_registry ar
    LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.DatabasesV dbv
        ON dbv.DatabaseName = ar.memory_database
    WHERE ar.memory_database IS NOT NULL
      AND dbv.DatabaseName IS NULL
)
SELECT
    product_id
   ,issue_code
   ,issue_detail
   ,repair_hint
FROM registry_issues
ORDER BY 2, 1;

sample_rows.recipe_title: Daily Call Volume by Agent and Day of Week
sample_rows.sql_template: SELECT    ah.agent_name,    ch.day_of_week,    COUNT(*)   AS call_countFROM CallCentre_DOM_BUS_V.Call_Current chJOIN CallCentre_DOM_BUS_V.Agent_Current ah    ON ch.agent_id = ah.agent_idWHERE 1=1 GROUP BY ah.agent_name, ch.day_of_weekORDER BY ah.agent_name, call_count DESC;

SELECT    category_name   ,COUNT(*) AS call_count   ,SUM(CASE WHEN all_hit_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS all_hit_call_count   ,ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN all_hit_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIFZERO(COUNT(*)), 2) AS all_hit_pctFROM(    SELECT call_id, 'Communication Quality' AS category_name, CASE WHEN communication_composite_score >= :quality_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS all_hit_flag    FROM CallCentre_PRE_BUS_V.call_features_enriched    UNION ALL    SELECT call_id, 'Customer Experience' AS category_name, CASE WHEN cx_composite_score >= :quality_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS all_hit_flag    FROM CallCentre_PRE_BUS_V.call_features_enriched    UNION ALL    SELECT call_id, 'Compliance' AS category_name, CASE WHEN compliance_composite_score >= :quality_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS all_hit_flag    FROM CallCentre_PRE_BUS_V.call_features_enriched    UNION ALL    SELECT call_id, 'Resolution' AS category_name, CASE WHEN resolution_composite_score >= :quality_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS all_hit_flag    FROM CallCentre_PRE_BUS_V.call_features_enriched    UNION ALL    SELECT call_id, 'Difficult Situations' AS category_name, CASE WHEN difficult_situations_composite_score >= :quality_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS all_hit_flag    FROM CallCentre_PRE_BUS_V.call_features_enriched) AS category_hitsGROUP BY category_nameORDER BY all_hit_pct ASC

SELECT TOP :top_k    ce.call_id   ,ce.agent_id   ,agt.agent_name   ,ce.day_of_week   ,ce.topic   ,cdc.caller_start_sentiment   ,cdc.caller_end_sentiment   ,cdc.caller_intra_call_change_in_sentimentFROM CallCentre_DOM_BUS_V.Call_Dynamics_Current AS cdcINNER JOIN CallCentre_DOM_BUS_V.Call_Enriched AS ce   ON ce.call_id = cdc.call_idINNER JOIN CallCentre_DOM_BUS_V.Agent_Current AS agt   ON agt.agent_id = ce.agent_idWHERE cdc.caller_start_sentiment < 0  AND cdc.caller_end_sentiment > 0ORDER BY cdc.caller_intra_call_change_in_sentiment DESC

SELECT    ch.start_hour   ,COUNT(*)                                         AS call_count   ,ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_of_totalFROM CallCentre_DOM_BUS_V.Call_Current chWHERE 1=1  AND ch.start_hour IS NOT NULLGROUP BY ch.start_hourORDER BY ch.start_hour;

SELECT TOP :top_k    ce.call_id   ,ce.agent_id   ,agt.agent_name   ,ce.day_of_week   ,ce.topic   ,cdc.caller_start_sentiment   ,cdc.caller_end_sentiment   ,cdc.caller_intra_call_change_in_sentimentFROM CallCentre_DOM_BUS_V.Call_Dynamics_Current AS cdcINNER JOIN CallCentre_DOM_BUS_V.Call_Enriched AS ce   ON ce.call_id = cdc.call_idINNER JOIN CallCentre_DOM_BUS_V.Agent_Current AS agt   ON agt.agent_id = ce.agent_idWHERE cdc.caller_intra_call_change_in_sentiment < :sentiment_drop_thresholdORDER BY cdc.caller_intra_call_change_in_sentiment ASC

sample_rows.recipe_title: Top 20 lowest quality calls  -  coaching priority list with source category breakdowns
sample_rows.sql_template:
SELECT
    f.call_id
   ,c.agent_name
   ,c.day_of_week
   ,c.topic
   ,f.overall_quality_score
   ,cat.communication_quality_avg_sim    AS src_communication_quality
   ,cat.conduct_and_professionalism_avg_sim AS src_conduct
   ,cat.customer_experience_avg_sim      AS src_customer_experience
   ,cat.compliance_avg_sim               AS src_compliance
   ,cat.call_handling_avg_sim            AS src_call_handling
   ,cat.compliance_all_hit
FROM CallCentre_PRE_BUS_V.call_features_current f
INNER JOIN CallCentre_DOM_BUS_V.Call_Enriched c
    ON c.call_id = f.call_id
LEFT JOIN CallCentre_DOM_BUS_V.Call_Category_Score_Current cat
    ON cat.call_id = f.call_id
WHERE CAST(f.observation_dts AS DATE) = :observation_date
ORDER BY f.overall_quality_score ASC
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY f.overall_quality_score ASC) <= 20;

SELECT TOP :top_k    call_id   ,agent_id   ,agent_name   ,day_of_week   ,topic   ,overall_quality_score   ,cx_composite_score   ,communication_composite_score   ,resolution_composite_score   ,compliance_composite_scoreFROM CallCentre_PRE_BUS_V.call_features_enrichedWHERE overall_quality_score >= :quality_threshold  AND cx_composite_score >= :quality_thresholdORDER BY overall_quality_score DESC, cx_composite_score DESC

SELECT    behaviour_segment   ,COUNT(*) AS call_count   ,ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / NULLIFZERO(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER ()), 2) AS call_pct   ,ROUND(AVG(cx_composite_score), 4) AS avg_customer_experience   ,ROUND(AVG(overall_quality_score), 4) AS avg_overall_qualityFROM(    SELECT        CASE        WHEN active_listening_norm >= :quality_threshold AND empathy_statements_norm >= :quality_threshold THEN 'Both Strong'        WHEN active_listening_norm >= :quality_threshold THEN 'Active Listening Only'        WHEN empathy_statements_norm >= :quality_threshold THEN 'Empathy Only'        ELSE 'Neither Strong'         END AS behaviour_segment       ,cx_composite_score       ,overall_quality_score    FROM CallCentre_PRE_BUS_V.call_features_enriched) AS behaviour_callsGROUP BY behaviour_segmentORDER BY avg_customer_experience DESC

SELECT TOP :top_k    call_id   ,agent_id   ,agent_name   ,day_of_week   ,topic   ,regulatory_obligations_norm   ,privacy_disclosure_norm   ,consent_gathering_norm   ,identity_verification_norm   ,call_recording_disclosure_norm   ,terms_and_conditions_explained_norm   ,compliance_composite_scoreFROM CallCentre_PRE_BUS_V.call_features_enrichedWHERE regulatory_obligations_norm < :quality_threshold   OR privacy_disclosure_norm < :quality_threshold   OR consent_gathering_norm < :quality_threshold   OR identity_verification_norm < :quality_threshold   OR call_recording_disclosure_norm < :quality_threshold   OR terms_and_conditions_explained_norm < :quality_thresholdORDER BY compliance_composite_score ASC

SELECT    dqm.database_name,    dqm.table_name,    dqm.metric_name,    dqm.metric_category,    dqm.metric_value,    dqm.quality_threshold,    dqm.is_threshold_met,    dqm.sample_size,    dqm.measured_dtsFROM CallCentre_OBS_STD_T.data_quality_metric dqmWHERE dqm.measured_dts = (    SELECT MAX(measured_dts)    FROM CallCentre_OBS_STD_T.data_quality_metric)ORDER BY dqm.is_threshold_met ASC,    -- breaches first         dqm.table_name,         dqm.metric_name;

test_case.expected_result: Returns zero rows for tables above the AMP skew threshold.
test_case.name: Tables have acceptable AMP storage skew
test_case.repair_strategy: Review the table primary index, data distribution, and collected statistics.
test_case.sql:
WITH table_amp_usage AS
(
    SELECT
        TRIM(tsv.DatabaseName) AS database_name
       ,TRIM(tsv.TableName) AS table_name
       ,tsv.Vproc AS amp_id
       ,COALESCE(tsv.CurrentPerm, 0) AS current_perm_bytes
    FROM DBC.TableSizeV tsv
    INNER JOIN DBC.TablesV tv
        ON tv.DatabaseName = tsv.DatabaseName
       AND tv.TableName = tsv.TableName
    WHERE tsv.DatabaseName LIKE 'CallCentre\_%' ESCAPE '\'
      AND tv.TableKind = 'T'
      AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM CallCentre_SEM_STD_V.data_product_map module_scope
    WHERE COALESCE(module_scope.is_active, 1) = 1
      AND UPPER(COALESCE(TRIM(module_scope.deployment_status), 'DEPLOYED')) = 'DEPLOYED'
      AND (
          UPPER(TRIM(module_scope.database_name)) = UPPER(TRIM(tsv.DatabaseName))
          OR UPPER(OREPLACE(OREPLACE(TRIM(module_scope.database_name), '_STD_T', '_STD_V'), '_BUS_V', '_STD_V'))
                = UPPER(TRIM(tsv.DatabaseName))
          OR UPPER(OREPLACE(OREPLACE(TRIM(module_scope.database_name), '_STD_T', '_BUS_V'), '_STD_V', '_BUS_V'))
                = UPPER(TRIM(tsv.DatabaseName))
      )
)
      AND UPPER(TRIM(tsv.TableName)) NOT LIKE '%\_BKP\_%' ESCAPE '\'
      AND UPPER(TRIM(tsv.TableName)) NOT LIKE '%\_BK\_%' ESCAPE '\'
),
table_skew AS
(
    SELECT
        database_name
       ,table_name
       ,COUNT(*) AS amp_count
       ,SUM(current_perm_bytes) AS total_perm_bytes
       ,MIN(current_perm_bytes) AS min_amp_perm_bytes
       ,MAX(current_perm_bytes) AS max_amp_perm_bytes
       ,AVG(current_perm_bytes) AS avg_amp_perm_bytes
       ,CASE
            WHEN MAX(current_perm_bytes) = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE 100 - ((AVG(current_perm_bytes) / MAX(current_perm_bytes)) * 100)
        END AS skew_percent
    FROM table_amp_usage
    GROUP BY database_name, table_name
)
SELECT
    database_name
   ,table_name
   ,amp_count
   ,total_perm_bytes
   ,min_amp_perm_bytes
   ,max_amp_perm_bytes
   ,avg_amp_perm_bytes
   ,skew_percent
   ,'TABLE_AMP_SKEW' AS issue_code
   ,'Review primary index choice or data distribution for this table.' AS repair_hint
FROM table_skew
WHERE total_perm_bytes > 0
  AND amp_count > 1
  AND skew_percent > 20
ORDER BY skew_percent DESC, total_perm_bytes DESC, database_name, table_name;

test_case.expected_result: Returns zero rows for product tables with suspicious primary index health.
test_case.name: Product tables have healthy primary index definitions
test_case.repair_strategy: Review missing, nullable, low-cardinality-looking or highly skewed primary indexes. Document intentional designs; otherwise adjust the table or view-layer access strategy.
test_case.sql:
WITH product_tables AS
(
    SELECT
        TRIM(tv.DatabaseName) AS database_name
       ,TRIM(tv.TableName) AS table_name
       ,COALESCE(tv.PIColumnCount, 0) AS pi_column_count
    FROM DBC.TablesV tv
    WHERE tv.DatabaseName LIKE 'CallCentre\_%' ESCAPE '\'
      AND tv.TableKind = 'T'
      AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM CallCentre_SEM_STD_V.data_product_map module_scope
    WHERE COALESCE(module_scope.is_active, 1) = 1
      AND UPPER(COALESCE(TRIM(module_scope.deployment_status), 'DEPLOYED')) = 'DEPLOYED'
      AND (
          UPPER(TRIM(module_scope.database_name)) = UPPER(TRIM(tv.DatabaseName))
          OR UPPER(OREPLACE(OREPLACE(TRIM(module_scope.database_name), '_STD_T', '_STD_V'), '_BUS_V', '_STD_V'))
                = UPPER(TRIM(tv.DatabaseName))
          OR UPPER(OREPLACE(OREPLACE(TRIM(module_scope.database_name), '_STD_T', '_BUS_V'), '_STD_V', '_BUS_V'))
                = UPPER(TRIM(tv.DatabaseName))
      )
)
      AND UPPER(TRIM(tv.TableName)) NOT LIKE '%\_BKP\_%' ESCAPE '\'
      AND UPPER(TRIM(tv.TableName)) NOT LIKE '%\_BK\_%' ESCAPE '\'
),
table_size AS
(
    SELECT
        TRIM(tsv.DatabaseName) AS database_name
       ,TRIM(tsv.TableName) AS table_name
       ,COUNT(*) AS amp_count
       ,SUM(COALESCE(tsv.CurrentPerm, 0)) AS total_perm_bytes
       ,MIN(COALESCE(tsv.CurrentPerm, 0)) AS min_amp_perm_bytes
       ,MAX(COALESCE(tsv.CurrentPerm, 0)) AS max_amp_perm_bytes
       ,AVG(COALESCE(tsv.CurrentPerm, 0)) AS avg_amp_perm_bytes
       ,CASE
            WHEN MAX(COALESCE(tsv.CurrentPerm, 0)) = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE 100 - (
                (AVG(COALESCE(tsv.CurrentPerm, 0)) / MAX(COALESCE(tsv.CurrentPerm, 0))) * 100
            )
        END AS skew_percent
    FROM DBC.TableSizeV tsv
    WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM CallCentre_SEM_STD_V.data_product_map module_scope
    WHERE COALESCE(module_scope.is_active, 1) = 1
      AND UPPER(COALESCE(TRIM(module_scope.deployment_status), 'DEPLOYED')) = 'DEPLOYED'
      AND (
          UPPER(TRIM(module_scope.database_name)) = UPPER(TRIM(tsv.DatabaseName))
          OR UPPER(OREPLACE(OREPLACE(TRIM(module_scope.database_name), '_STD_T', '_STD_V'), '_BUS_V', '_STD_V'))
                = UPPER(TRIM(tsv.DatabaseName))
          OR UPPER(OREPLACE(OREPLACE(TRIM(module_scope.database_name), '_STD_T', '_BUS_V'), '_STD_V', '_BUS_V'))
                = UPPER(TRIM(tsv.DatabaseName))
      )
)
      AND UPPER(TRIM(tsv.TableName)) NOT LIKE '%\_BKP\_%' ESCAPE '\'
      AND UPPER(TRIM(tsv.TableName)) NOT LIKE '%\_BK\_%' ESCAPE '\'
    GROUP BY TRIM(tsv.DatabaseName), TRIM(tsv.TableName)
),
primary_index_column_rows AS
(
    SELECT
        TRIM(iv.DatabaseName) AS database_name
       ,TRIM(iv.TableName) AS table_name
       ,TRIM(iv.ColumnName) AS column_name
       ,iv.ColumnPosition AS column_position
       ,COALESCE(colv.Nullable, 'N') AS nullable_flag
    FROM DBC.IndicesV iv
    LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.ColumnsV colv
        ON colv.DatabaseName = iv.DatabaseName
       AND colv.TableName = iv.TableName
       AND colv.ColumnName = iv.ColumnName
    WHERE iv.IndexNumber = 1
      AND iv.IndexType IN ('P', 'Q', 'A', 'K')
      AND iv.DatabaseName LIKE 'CallCentre\_%' ESCAPE '\'
      AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM CallCentre_SEM_STD_V.data_product_map module_scope
    WHERE COALESCE(module_scope.is_active, 1) = 1
      AND UPPER(COALESCE(TRIM(module_scope.deployment_status), 'DEPLOYED')) = 'DEPLOYED'
      AND (
          UPPER(TRIM(module_scope.database_name)) = UPPER(TRIM(iv.DatabaseName))
          OR UPPER(OREPLACE(OREPLACE(TRIM(module_scope.database_name), '_STD_T', '_STD_V'), '_BUS_V', '_STD_V'))
                = UPPER(TRIM(iv.DatabaseName))
          OR UPPER(OREPLACE(OREPLACE(TRIM(module_scope.database_name), '_STD_T', '_BUS_V'), '_STD_V', '_BUS_V'))
                = UPPER(TRIM(iv.DatabaseName))
      )
)
      AND UPPER(TRIM(iv.TableName)) NOT LIKE '%\_BKP\_%' ESCAPE '\'
      AND UPPER(TRIM(iv.TableName)) NOT LIKE '%\_BK\_%' ESCAPE '\'
),
primary_index_columns AS
(
    SELECT
        picr.database_name
       ,picr.table_name
       ,MIN(picr.column_name) AS primary_index_columns
       ,COUNT(*) AS primary_index_column_count
       ,SUM(CASE WHEN picr.nullable_flag = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nullable_pi_column_count
       ,MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN UPPER(picr.column_name) LIKE '%STATUS%'
                  OR UPPER(picr.column_name) LIKE '%TYPE%'
                  OR UPPER(picr.column_name) LIKE '%FLAG%'
                  OR UPPER(picr.column_name) LIKE '%GENDER%'
                  OR UPPER(picr.column_name) LIKE '%CATEGORY%'
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS suspicious_low_cardinality_name
    FROM primary_index_column_rows picr
    GROUP BY picr.database_name, picr.table_name
),
primary_index_issues AS
(
    SELECT
        pt.database_name
       ,pt.table_name
       ,COALESCE(pic.primary_index_columns, '') AS primary_index_columns
       ,COALESCE(ts.total_perm_bytes, 0) AS total_perm_bytes
       ,COALESCE(ts.skew_percent, 0) AS skew_percent
       ,'PRIMARY_INDEX_NOT_DEFINED' AS issue_code
       ,'Define and document an intentional primary index, or explicitly justify NoPI table design.' AS repair_hint
    FROM product_tables pt
    LEFT OUTER JOIN primary_index_columns pic
        ON pic.database_name = pt.database_name
       AND pic.table_name = pt.table_name
    LEFT OUTER JOIN table_size ts
        ON ts.database_name = pt.database_name
       AND ts.table_name = pt.table_name
    WHERE pt.pi_column_count = 0
      AND pic.table_name IS NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        pt.database_name
       ,pt.table_name
       ,pic.primary_index_columns
       ,COALESCE(ts.total_perm_bytes, 0)
       ,COALESCE(ts.skew_percent, 0)
       ,'PRIMARY_INDEX_NULLABLE_COLUMN' AS issue_code
       ,'Review nullable primary index columns; NULL-heavy PI values can concentrate rows on a small number of AMPs.' AS repair_hint
    FROM product_tables pt
    INNER JOIN primary_index_columns pic
        ON pic.database_name = pt.database_name
       AND pic.table_name = pt.table_name
    LEFT OUTER JOIN table_size ts
        ON ts.database_name = pt.database_name
       AND ts.table_name = pt.table_name
    WHERE pic.nullable_pi_column_count > 0

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        pt.database_name
       ,pt.table_name
       ,pic.primary_index_columns
       ,COALESCE(ts.total_perm_bytes, 0)
       ,COALESCE(ts.skew_percent, 0)
       ,'PRIMARY_INDEX_LOW_CARDINALITY_SUSPECT' AS issue_code
       ,'Review low-cardinality-looking primary index columns and document the design if intentional.' AS repair_hint
    FROM product_tables pt
    INNER JOIN primary_index_columns pic
        ON pic.database_name = pt.database_name
       AND pic.table_name = pt.table_name
    LEFT OUTER JOIN table_size ts
        ON ts.database_name = pt.database_name
       AND ts.table_name = pt.table_name
    WHERE pic.primary_index_column_count = 1
      AND pic.suspicious_low_cardinality_name = 1

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        pt.database_name
       ,pt.table_name
       ,COALESCE(pic.primary_index_columns, '') AS primary_index_columns
       ,COALESCE(ts.total_perm_bytes, 0)
       ,COALESCE(ts.skew_percent, 0)
       ,'PRIMARY_INDEX_SKEW_HIGH' AS issue_code
       ,'Review primary index choice because observed AMP storage skew is above the initial warning threshold.' AS repair_hint
    FROM product_tables pt
    INNER JOIN table_size ts
        ON ts.database_name = pt.database_name
       AND ts.table_name = pt.table_name
    LEFT OUTER JOIN primary_index_columns pic
        ON pic.database_name = pt.database_name
       AND pic.table_name = pt.table_name
    WHERE ts.total_perm_bytes > 0
      AND ts.amp_count > 1
      AND ts.skew_percent > 20
)
SELECT
    database_name
   ,table_name
   ,primary_index_columns
   ,total_perm_bytes
   ,skew_percent
   ,issue_code
   ,repair_hint
FROM primary_index_issues
ORDER BY 6, 5 DESC, 4 DESC, 1, 2;

test_case.name: Relationship join columns have valid optimiser statistics
test_case.repair_strategy: Collect or refresh optimiser statistics on relationship join columns.
test_case.sql:
WITH required_stats AS
(
    SELECT DISTINCT
        tr.source_database AS database_name
       ,tr.source_table AS table_name
       ,tr.source_column AS column_name
       ,tr.relationship_name
       ,'RELATIONSHIP_SOURCE_JOIN' AS usage_type
    FROM CallCentre_SEM_STD_V.table_relationship tr
    WHERE COALESCE(tr.is_active, 1) = 1
      AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM CallCentre_SEM_STD_V.data_product_map module_scope
    WHERE COALESCE(module_scope.is_active, 1) = 1
      AND UPPER(COALESCE(TRIM(module_scope.deployment_status), 'DEPLOYED')) = 'DEPLOYED'
      AND (
          UPPER(TRIM(module_scope.database_name)) = UPPER(TRIM(tr.source_database))
          OR UPPER(OREPLACE(OREPLACE(TRIM(module_scope.database_name), '_STD_T', '_STD_V'), '_BUS_V', '_STD_V'))
                = UPPER(TRIM(tr.source_database))
          OR UPPER(OREPLACE(OREPLACE(TRIM(module_scope.database_name), '_STD_T', '_BUS_V'), '_STD_V', '_BUS_V'))
                = UPPER(TRIM(tr.source_database))
      )
)
      AND tr.source_database IS NOT NULL
      AND tr.source_table IS NOT NULL
      AND tr.source_column IS NOT NULL
      AND UPPER(TRIM(tr.source_table)) NOT LIKE '%\_BKP\_%' ESCAPE '\'
      AND UPPER(TRIM(tr.source_table)) NOT LIKE '%\_BK\_%' ESCAPE '\'
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT
        tr.target_database AS database_name
       ,tr.target_table AS table_name
       ,tr.target_column AS column_name
       ,tr.relationship_name
       ,'RELATIONSHIP_TARGET_JOIN' AS usage_type
    FROM CallCentre_SEM_STD_V.table_relationship tr
    WHERE COALESCE(tr.is_active, 1) = 1
      AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM CallCentre_SEM_STD_V.data_product_map module_scope
    WHERE COALESCE(module_scope.is_active, 1) = 1
      AND UPPER(COALESCE(TRIM(module_scope.deployment_status), 'DEPLOYED')) = 'DEPLOYED'
      AND (
          UPPER(TRIM(module_scope.database_name)) = UPPER(TRIM(tr.target_database))
          OR UPPER(OREPLACE(OREPLACE(TRIM(module_scope.database_name), '_STD_T', '_STD_V'), '_BUS_V', '_STD_V'))
                = UPPER(TRIM(tr.target_database))
          OR UPPER(OREPLACE(OREPLACE(TRIM(module_scope.database_name), '_STD_T', '_BUS_V'), '_STD_V', '_BUS_V'))
                = UPPER(TRIM(tr.target_database))
      )
)
      AND tr.target_database IS NOT NULL
      AND tr.target_table IS NOT NULL
      AND tr.target_column IS NOT NULL
      AND UPPER(TRIM(tr.target_table)) NOT LIKE '%\_BKP\_%' ESCAPE '\'
      AND UPPER(TRIM(tr.target_table)) NOT LIKE '%\_BK\_%' ESCAPE '\'
),
deployed_columns AS
(
    SELECT
        rs.database_name
       ,rs.table_name
       ,rs.column_name
       ,rs.relationship_name
       ,rs.usage_type
    FROM required_stats rs
    INNER JOIN DBC.ColumnsV colv
        ON colv.DatabaseName = rs.database_name
       AND colv.TableName = rs.table_name
       AND colv.ColumnName = rs.column_name
),
valid_column_stats AS
(
    SELECT
        statv.DatabaseName AS database_name
       ,statv.TableName AS table_name
       ,statv.ColumnName AS stats_columns
       ,statv.LastCollectTimeStamp AS last_collect_timestamp
    FROM DBC.ColumnStatsV statv
    WHERE statv.ValidStats = 'Y'
      AND UPPER(TRIM(statv.TableName)) NOT LIKE '%\_BKP\_%' ESCAPE '\'
      AND UPPER(TRIM(statv.TableName)) NOT LIKE '%\_BK\_%' ESCAPE '\'
)
SELECT
    dc.database_name
   ,dc.table_name
   ,dc.column_name
   ,dc.relationship_name
   ,dc.usage_type
   ,'MISSING_JOIN_COLUMN_STATS' AS issue_code
   ,'COLLECT STATISTICS COLUMN (' || dc.column_name || ') ON '
        || dc.database_name || '.' || dc.table_name || ';' AS repair_hint
FROM deployed_columns dc
LEFT OUTER JOIN valid_column_stats vcs
    ON vcs.database_name = dc.database_name
   AND vcs.table_name = dc.table_name
   AND POSITION(
        ',' || UPPER(TRIM(dc.column_name)) || ','
        IN ',' || UPPER(
            OREPLACE(OREPLACE(OREPLACE(vcs.stats_columns, ' ', ''), '(', ''), ')', '')
        ) || ','
   ) > 0
WHERE vcs.stats_columns IS NULL
ORDER BY dc.database_name, dc.table_name, dc.column_name, dc.relationship_name;

test_case.sql: SELECT    agent_cur.agent_name   ,COUNT(DISTINCT call_topic_cur.topic) AS distinct_topics_handled   ,MAX(topic_summary.dominant_topic) (TITLE 'Dominant Topic') AS dominant_topic   ,MAX(topic_summary.dominant_call_count) AS dominant_topic_callsFROM CallCentre_DOM_BUS_V.Call_Current call_curJOIN CallCentre_DOM_BUS_V.Agent_Current agent_cur    ON call_cur.agent_id = agent_cur.agent_idLEFT JOIN CallCentre_DOM_BUS_V.Call_Topic_Current call_topic_cur    ON call_cur.call_id = call_topic_cur.call_idLEFT JOIN (    SELECT        call_cur_2.agent_id       ,call_topic_cur_2.topic AS dominant_topic       ,COUNT(*) AS dominant_call_count       ,RANK() OVER (            PARTITION BY call_cur_2.agent_id            ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC        ) AS rnk    FROM CallCentre_DOM_BUS_V.Call_Current call_cur_2    JOIN CallCentre_DOM_BUS_V.Call_Topic_Current call_topic_cur_2        ON call_cur_2.call_id = call_topic_cur_2.call_id    WHERE 1=1    GROUP BY call_cur_2.agent_id, call_topic_cur_2.topic) topic_summary    ON call_cur.agent_id = topic_summary.agent_id   AND topic_summary.rnk = 1WHERE 1=1GROUP BY agent_cur.agent_nameORDER BY distinct_topics_handled DESC, agent_cur.agent_name;

test_case.sql: WITH agent_topic_volume AS (    SELECT        agent_cur.agent_name       ,call_topic_cur.topic       ,COUNT(*) AS agent_calls_in_topic    FROM CallCentre_DOM_BUS_V.Call_Current call_cur    JOIN CallCentre_DOM_BUS_V.Agent_Current agent_cur        ON call_cur.agent_id = agent_cur.agent_id    JOIN CallCentre_DOM_BUS_V.Call_Topic_Current call_topic_cur        ON call_cur.call_id = call_topic_cur.call_id    WHERE 1=1      AND agent_cur.agent_name = :agent_name    GROUP BY agent_cur.agent_name, call_topic_cur.topic),topic_totals AS (    SELECT        call_topic_cur.topic       ,COUNT(*) AS total_calls_in_topic    FROM CallCentre_DOM_BUS_V.Call_Topic_Current call_topic_cur    JOIN CallCentre_DOM_BUS_V.Call_Current call_cur        ON call_topic_cur.call_id = call_cur.call_id    WHERE 1=1    GROUP BY call_topic_cur.topic)SELECT    agent_topic_volume.agent_name   ,agent_topic_volume.topic   ,agent_topic_volume.agent_calls_in_topic   ,topic_totals.total_calls_in_topic   ,ROUND(100.0 * agent_topic_volume.agent_calls_in_topic / NULLIFZERO(topic_totals.total_calls_in_topic), 1)        AS pct_of_topic_at_riskFROM agent_topic_volumeJOIN topic_totals    ON agent_topic_volume.topic = topic_totals.topicORDER BY pct_of_topic_at_risk DESC;

test_case.expected_result: Every %_STD_T table has a same-named %_STD_V access view for governed agent and application access.
test_case.name: Standard tables have matching locking views
test_case.repair_strategy: Create the matching %_STD_V view with an explicit column list, LOCKING ROW FOR ACCESS, and a 1:1 projection over the table.
test_case.sql:
WITH standard_tables AS
(
    SELECT
        TRIM(DatabaseName) AS table_database_name
       ,TRIM(TableName) AS table_name
       ,TRIM(SUBSTRING(DatabaseName FROM 1 FOR CHARACTER_LENGTH(DatabaseName) - 6) || '_STD_V')
            AS expected_view_database_name
       ,TRIM(TableName) AS expected_view_name
    FROM DBC.TablesV
    WHERE DatabaseName LIKE 'CallCentre\_%\_STD\_T' ESCAPE '\'
      AND TableKind = 'T'
      AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM CallCentre_SEM_STD_V.data_product_map module_scope
    WHERE COALESCE(module_scope.is_active, 1) = 1
      AND UPPER(COALESCE(TRIM(module_scope.deployment_status), 'DEPLOYED')) = 'DEPLOYED'
      AND (
          UPPER(TRIM(module_scope.database_name)) = UPPER(TRIM(DatabaseName))
          OR UPPER(OREPLACE(OREPLACE(TRIM(module_scope.database_name), '_STD_T', '_STD_V'), '_BUS_V', '_STD_V'))
                = UPPER(TRIM(DatabaseName))
          OR UPPER(OREPLACE(OREPLACE(TRIM(module_scope.database_name), '_STD_T', '_BUS_V'), '_STD_V', '_BUS_V'))
                = UPPER(TRIM(DatabaseName))
      )
)
      AND UPPER(TRIM(TableName)) NOT LIKE '%\_BKP\_%' ESCAPE '\'
      AND UPPER(TRIM(TableName)) NOT LIKE '%\_BK\_%' ESCAPE '\'
),
missing_views AS
(
    SELECT
        st.table_database_name
       ,st.table_name
       ,st.expected_view_database_name
       ,st.expected_view_name
       ,'MISSING_STANDARD_LOCKING_VIEW' AS issue_code
       ,'Create a same-named %_STD_V locking 1:1 access view.' AS repair_hint
    FROM standard_tables st
    LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.TablesV tv
        ON tv.DatabaseName = st.expected_view_database_name
       AND tv.TableName = st.expected_view_name
       AND tv.TableKind = 'V'
    WHERE tv.TableName IS NULL
)
SELECT
    table_database_name
   ,table_name
   ,expected_view_database_name
   ,expected_view_name
   ,issue_code
   ,repair_hint
FROM missing_views
ORDER BY table_database_name, table_name

test_case.sql: /* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------   Call_Summary_Current  current-state business view over Call_Summary_H.   Hardened to guarantee exactly one row per call_id even if a duplicate   current row is ever (re)introduced upstream. The QUALIFY makes every   consumer of this view fan-out-proof, including DOM_BUS_V.Call_Enriched,   which previously multiplied calls that had duplicate current summaries.   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */REPLACE VIEW CallCentre_DOM_BUS_V.Call_Summary_Current(    call_summary_id   ,call_id   ,conversation_summary   ,valid_from_dts   ,valid_to_dts)ASSELECT    call_summary_id   ,call_id   ,conversation_summary   ,valid_from_dts   ,valid_to_dtsFROM CallCentre_DOM_STD_V.Call_Summary_HWHERE is_current = 1  AND is_deleted = 0QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY call_id ORDER BY call_summary_id) = 1;

test_case.sql: REPLACE VIEW CallCentre_SEM_BUS_V.relationship_paths(    source_table   ,target_table   ,path_tables   ,path_joins   ,hop_count   ,path_description)ASWITH RECURSIVE relationship_paths (    source_table   ,target_table   ,path_tables   ,path_joins   ,hop_count   ,path_description) AS (    -- Anchor: forward direction (1-hop)    SELECT        source_table       ,target_table       ,source_table || ' -> ' || target_table       ,'JOIN ' || target_table || ' ON '            || target_table || '.' || target_column || ' = '            || source_table || '.' || source_column       ,1       ,relationship_description    FROM CallCentre_SEM_STD_V.table_relationship    WHERE is_active = 1    UNION ALL    -- Anchor: reverse direction (1-hop backward)    SELECT        target_table       ,source_table       ,target_table || ' -> ' || source_table       ,'JOIN ' || source_table || ' ON '            || source_table || '.' || source_column || ' = '            || target_table || '.' || target_column       ,1       ,'REVERSE: ' || relationship_description    FROM CallCentre_SEM_STD_V.table_relationship    WHERE is_active = 1    UNION ALL    -- Recursive: forward multi-hop    SELECT        rp.source_table       ,tr.target_table       ,rp.path_tables || ' -> ' || tr.target_table       ,rp.path_joins || ' | JOIN ' || tr.target_table || ' ON '            || tr.target_table || '.' || tr.target_column || ' = '            || tr.source_table || '.' || tr.source_column       ,rp.hop_count + 1       ,rp.path_description || ' -> ' || tr.relationship_description    FROM relationship_paths rp    INNER JOIN CallCentre_SEM_STD_V.table_relationship tr        ON tr.source_table = rp.target_table       AND tr.is_active = 1    WHERE rp.hop_count < 5      AND rp.path_tables NOT LIKE '%' || tr.target_table || '%'    UNION ALL    -- Recursive: backward multi-hop    SELECT        rp.source_table       ,tr.source_table       ,rp.path_tables || ' -> ' || tr.source_table       ,rp.path_joins || ' | JOIN ' || tr.source_table || ' ON '            || tr.source_table || '.' || tr.source_column || ' = '            || tr.target_table || '.' || tr.target_column       ,rp.hop_count + 1       ,rp.path_description || ' -> REVERSE: ' || tr.relationship_description    FROM relationship_paths rp    INNER JOIN CallCentre_SEM_STD_V.table_relationship tr        ON tr.target_table = rp.target_table       AND tr.is_active = 1    WHERE rp.hop_count < 5      AND The QUALIFY makes every   consumer of this view fan-out-proof, including DOM_BUS_V.Call_Enriched,   which previously multiplied calls that had duplicate current summaries.   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */REPLACE VIEW CallCentre_DOM_BUS_V.Call_Summary_Current(    call_summary_id   ,call_id   ,conversation_summary   ,valid_from_dts   ,valid_to_dts)ASSELECT    call_summary_id   ,call_id   ,conversation_summary   ,valid_from_dts   ,valid_to_dtsFROM CallCentre_DOM_STD_V.Call_Summary_HWHERE is_current = 1  AND is_deleted = 0QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY call_id ORDER BY call_summary_id) = 1;

test_case.sql: REPLACE VIEW CallCentre_SEM_BUS_V.lineage_graph (    Src_Object_Name_FQ, Src_Container_Name, Src_Object_Name, Src_Kind, Src_Display_Name,    Edge_Relationship, Transformation_Type, Transformation_Logic, Lineage_ID,    Tgt_Object_Name_FQ, Tgt_Container_Name, Tgt_Object_Name, Tgt_Kind, Tgt_Display_Name) AS    -- Leg 1: source table -> job (ETL_INPUT)    SELECT         COALESCE(dl.source_database, '') || '.' || dl.source_table        AS Src_Object_Name_FQ,         CAST(COALESCE(dl.source_database, '') AS VARCHAR(128))             AS Src_Container_Name,         CAST(dl.source_table AS VARCHAR(128))                             AS Src_Object_Name,         CAST(CASE WHEN Src_Obj.TableKind = 'T' THEN 'Table'                   WHEN Src_Obj.TableKind = 'O' THEN 'No PI Table'                   WHEN Src_Obj.TableKind = 'V' THEN 'View'                   ELSE 'Unknown' END AS VARCHAR(30))                      AS Src_Kind,         COALESCE(dl.source_database, '') || '.' || dl.source_table           || '0A'xc || ' [' || Src_Kind || ']'                           AS Src_Display_Name,         CAST('ETL_INPUT' AS VARCHAR(12))                                  AS Edge_Relationship,         dl.transformation_type                                           AS Transformation_Type,         dl.transformation_logic                                          AS Transformation_Logic,         dl.lineage_id                                                    AS Lineage_ID,         CAST(dl.job_name AS VARCHAR(128))                                 AS Tgt_Object_Name_FQ,         CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128))                                          AS Tgt_Container_Name,         CAST(dl.job_name AS VARCHAR(128))                                 AS Tgt_Object_Name,         CAST('Job' AS VARCHAR(30))                                        AS Tgt_Kind,         dl.job_name || '0A'xc || ' [Job]'                                AS Tgt_Display_Name    FROM CallCentre_SEM_STD_V.data_lineage AS dl    LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.TablesV AS Src_Obj      ON Src_Obj.DatabaseName = dl.source_database AND Src_Obj.TableName = dl.source_table    WHERE dl.is_active = 1    UNION ALL    -- Leg 2: job -> target table (ETL_OUTPUT)    SELECT         CAST(dl.job_name AS VARCHAR(128)),         CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)),         CAST(dl.job_name AS VARCHAR(128)),         CAST('Job' AS VARCHAR(30)),         dl.job_name || '0A'xc || ' [Job]',         CAST('ETL_OUTPUT' AS VARCHAR(12)),         dl.transformation_type,         dl.transformation_logic,         dl.lineage_id,         COALESCE(dl.target_database, '') || '.' || dl.target_table,         CAST(COALESCE(dl.target_database, '') AS VARCHAR(128)),         CAST(dl.target_table AS VARCHAR(128)),         CAST(CASE WHEN Tgt_Obj.TableKind = 'T' THEN 'Table'                   WHEN Tgt_Obj.TableKind = 'O' THEN 'No PI Table'                   WHEN Tgt_Obj.TableKind = 'V' THEN 'View'                   ELSE 'Unknown' END AS VARCHAR(30)),         COALESCE(dl.target_database, '') || '.' || dl.target_table || '0A'xc || ' [Tgt]'    FROM CallCentre_SEM_STD_V.data_lineage AS dl    LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.TablesV AS Tgt_Obj      ON Tgt_Obj.DatabaseName = dl.target_database AND Tgt_Obj.TableName = dl.target_table    WHERE dl.is_active = 1;

test_case.sql: REPLACE VIEW CallCentre_SEM_BUS_V.relationship_paths(    source_table   ,target_table   ,path_tables   ,path_joins   ,hop_count   ,path_description)ASWITH RECURSIVE relationship_paths (    source_table   ,target_table   ,path_tables   ,path_joins   ,hop_count   ,path_description) AS (    -- Anchor: forward direction (1-hop)    SELECT        source_table       ,target_table       ,source_table || ' -> ' || target_table       ,'JOIN ' || target_table || ' ON '            || target_table || '.' || target_column || ' = '            || source_table || '.' || source_column       ,1       ,relationship_description    FROM CallCentre_SEM_STD_V.table_relationship    WHERE is_active = 1    UNION ALL    -- Anchor: reverse direction (1-hop backward)    SELECT        target_table       ,source_table       ,target_table || ' -> ' || source_table       ,'JOIN ' || source_table || ' ON '            || source_table || '.' || source_column || ' = '            || target_table || '.' || target_column       ,1       ,'REVERSE: ' || relationship_description    FROM CallCentre_SEM_STD_V.table_relationship    WHERE is_active = 1    UNION ALL    -- Recursive: forward multi-hop    SELECT        rp.source_table       ,tr.target_table       ,rp.path_tables || ' -> ' || tr.target_table       ,rp.path_joins || ' | JOIN ' || tr.target_table || ' ON '            || tr.target_table || '.' || tr.target_column || ' = '            || tr.source_table || '.' || tr.source_column       ,rp.hop_count + 1       ,rp.path_description || ' -> ' || tr.relationship_description    FROM relationship_paths rp    INNER JOIN CallCentre_SEM_STD_V.table_relationship tr        ON tr.source_table = rp.target_table       AND tr.is_active = 1    WHERE rp.hop_count < 5      AND rp.path_tables NOT LIKE '%' || tr.target_table || '%'    UNION ALL    -- Recursive: backward multi-hop    SELECT        rp.source_table       ,tr.source_table       ,rp.path_tables || ' -> ' || tr.source_table       ,rp.path_joins || ' | JOIN ' || tr.source_table || ' ON '            || tr.source_table || '.' || tr.source_column || ' = '            || tr.target_table || '.' || tr.target_column       ,rp.hop_count + 1       ,rp.path_description || ' -> REVERSE: ' || tr.relationship_description    FROM relationship_paths rp    INNER JOIN CallCentre_SEM_STD_V.table_relationship tr        ON tr.target_table = rp.target_table       AND tr.is_active = 1    WHERE rp.hop_count < 5      AND rp.path_tables NOT LIKE '%' || tr.source_table || '%')SELECT    source_table   ,target_table   ,path_tables   ,path_joins   ,hop_count   ,path_descriptionFROM relationship_paths;
